title: Caching & CDN Setup
description: Configure full-page cache, CDN, and cache exclusion rules for production WordPress sites.

steps.title: Select Cache Strategy
steps.instructions: Document whether the site uses host edge cache, Cloudflare, or a plugin (WP Rocket, LiteSpeed, etc.). Avoid stacking conflicting page caches.

steps.title: Configure CDN Origin
steps.instructions: Point CDN to origin, enable HTTPS, and verify static assets (CSS, JS, fonts, images) serve from the CDN hostname.

steps.title: Exclude Dynamic Routes
steps.instructions: Exclude wp-admin, wp-login.php, cart, checkout, my-account, and logged-in user pages from full-page cache.

steps.title: Verify Cache Purge Hooks
steps.instructions: Confirm cache purges when content is published or WooCommerce products update. Test by editing a post and checking the live page.

steps.title: Set Browser Cache Headers
steps.instructions: Configure long-lived cache headers for static assets and short/no-cache for HTML on dynamic sites.

steps.title: Enable Compression
steps.instructions: Verify Brotli or Gzip compression is active for text assets. Check response headers on CSS and JS files.
